title: This patent trial in India took just 3 months - A model for all commercial cases
description: Three months. That’s how long the entire trial took in a patent dispute before the Delhi High Court.The Communication Components Antenna Inc. v. Rosenberger Hochfrequenztechnik GmbH & Co. KG & Ors. (CS(COMM) 653/2019), judgment from the Delhi High Court sets the benchmark on how courts can leverage summary provisions to prevent the usual process delays in deciding complex commercial disputes - especially patent disputes.
